legend.units: SCENE feet: x west -> east, z rear (north) -> street (south); 1 unit = 1 ft. Every number is a sheet coordinate scaled by 1/18 (1/4" = 1'-0") and shifted so the west wall's interior face is x 0.225 and the rear wall's interior face is z 0.225.

transform.note: sheet_pt values in this file are quoted to 0.01 pt (1111.12 stands for 1111.125, 365.86 for 365.858); they were converted with the origin rounded the same way (1107.07, 361.81)

legend.sheet_pt: [X0, Y0, X1, Y1] in PDF points on page 6 (origin top-left, y down)
legend.walls: face to face boxes; every wall on the sheet is 7.5 pt = 5 in thick. status comes from the sheet's 45-degree hatch (new walls).
legend.doors: start / end = rough opening between the heavy jamb lines; clear_* = between the 2 in (3 pt) frames = the leaf; hinge_xz = centre of the swing arc; leaf_ft = arc radius
legend.windows: start / end = between the heavy jamb lines along the wall
legend.accuracy: vector coordinates are exact to 0.01 pt (0.0006 ft); values are rounded to 0.001 ft
legend.ids: WL walls, R rooms, DR doors, WN windows, SK skylights, FX fixtures, KT kitchen, FN furniture, LD landings, ST steps
